data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Strategic Lines Seethe Across Divided Sectors
previous_model_summary.war_summary: The latest watch finds the chief struggle concentrated in a handful of divided sectors. Weathered Expanse leads the ledger with 56 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though none arrived in the newest two; its current holdings stand six Colonial to three Warden, while casualties and enlistments accelerate. Stlican Shelf follows with 40 events, two in the latest two hours, and a five-to-three Colonial advantage with one base neutral. Godcrofts has reached 30 events, but shows no fresh movement in two hours and now stands six Colonial to three Warden. Stonecradle records 17 events, including three recent changes, with four Colonial bases against five Warden. Callahan’s Passage is active again, posting three events in two hours amid sharply rising casualties and enlistments, though all ten bases remain Warden-held. Linn Mercy remains a heavily contested six-to-five Warden sector with 27 events, but its latest recorded movement is several hours old. Elsewhere, Fisherman’s Row and Marban Hollow remain watchable, while most other regions report no strategic-base activity.
